77b6d637bf703fc59d42da667715f8ae0653cece.summary: McAfee reported that Russia-linked APT28 used a Word document with a DDE technique, under a lure referencing the New York City attack, to deliver the Seduploader malware in an espionage campaign. The report says the campaign also used documents referencing the Saber Guardian military exercise and that the DDE campaign started on October 25. Cisco Talos separately observed APT28 spear-phishing lures referencing a NATO cybersecurity conference. The report says Microsoft did not plan to mitigate DDE.

7750dff6a2716c485cb9cd31d6d4cb3ad3009af2.summary: U.S. Department of Justice press release on the sentencing of Andrii Kolpakov, a Ukrainian national described as a high-level member of the FIN7 hacking group, also called Carbanak Group and Navigator Group. He received seven years in prison and was ordered to pay $2,500,000 in restitution. The report says FIN7 sent crafted emails with attached files, followed up with phone calls, and used an adapted Carbanak malware to steal payment card data from restaurant, gambling and hospitality businesses. More than 20 million card records were reportedly taken from over 6,500 point-of-sale terminals…

77a371ec2799b3a9d4de2af5b9b95db990307019.summary: Project page for chkrootkit, a locally run tool that checks Unix-like systems for signs of rootkits. It lists the tool's checks, a long list of rootkits, worms and LKMs it detects, tested platforms, and donation, shop and author contact information. It is a tool description and support page with no threat analysis of a specific incident, so it is not a threat report.
